072  @Test
073  public void testComplexQuery() throws QueryBuildingException {
074    Predicate aves =
075        new EqualsPredicate<>(
076            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY, "212", false, Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY);
077    Predicate passer =
078        new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, "Passer*", false);
079    Predicate UK = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "GB", false);
080    Predicate before1989 = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "1989");
081    Predicate georeferencedPredicate =
082        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.HAS_COORDINATE, "true", false);
083
084    ConjunctionPredicate p =
085        new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(aves, UK, passer, before1989, georeferencedPredicate));
086    String where = visitor.buildQuery(p);
087    assertEquals(
088        "(((stringArrayContains(occurrence.gbif_classification.taxonkeys, '212', true))) AND (countrycode = 'GB') AND (lower(occurrence.gbif_classification.scientificname) LIKE lower('Passer%')) AND (year <= 1989) AND (hascoordinate = true))",
089        where);
090  }

113  @Test
114  public void testMoreComplexQuery() throws QueryBuildingException {
115    Predicate taxon1 =
116        new EqualsPredicate<>(
117            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY, "1", false, Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY);
118    Predicate taxon2 =
119        new EqualsPredicate<>(
120            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY, "2", false, Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY);
121    DisjunctionPredicate taxa = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(taxon1, taxon2));
122
123    Predicate basis =
124        new InPredicate<>(
125            OccurrenceSearchParameter.BASIS_OF_RECORD,
126            List.of("HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "MACHINE_OBSERVATION"),
127            false);
128
129    Predicate UK = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "GB", false);
130    Predicate IE = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "IE", false);
131    DisjunctionPredicate countries = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(UK, IE));
132
133    Predicate before1989 = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "1989");
134    Predicate in2000 = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "2000", false);
135    DisjunctionPredicate years = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(before1989, in2000));
136
137    ConjunctionPredicate p = new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(taxa, basis, countries, years));
138    String where = visitor.buildQuery(p);
139    assertEquals(
140        "(((arrays_overlap(occurrence.gbif_classification.taxonkeys, array('1','2')))) "
141            + "AND ((basisofrecord IN('HUMAN_OBSERVATION', 'MACHINE_OBSERVATION'))) "
142            + "AND ((countrycode IN(\'GB\', \'IE\'))) "
143            + "AND (((year <= 1989) OR (year = 2000))))",
144        where);
145  }

258    Predicate p = new LikePredicate<>(PARAM, "v?l*ue_%", false);
259    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);

522        "MULTIPOLYGON (((180 -16.658979090909092, 180 -17.12485513597339, 179.87915 -17.12058, 179.78577 -16.82899, 179.85168 -16.72643, 180 -16.658979090909092)), ((-180 -17.12485513597339, -180 -16.658979090909092, -179.8764 -16.60277, -179.75006 -16.86054, -179.89838 -17.12845, -180 -17.12485513597339)))";
523    String bbox =
524        "(decimallatitude >= -17.12845 AND decimallatitude <= -16.60277 AND (decimallongitude >= 179.78577 OR decimallongitude <= -179.75006))";
525    query = visitor.buildQuery(new WithinPredicate(wktM));
526    assertEquals(
527        "(" + bbox + " AND contains('" + wktM + "', decimallatitude, decimallongitude) = TRUE)",
528        query);

530    // A polygon around Taveuni, Fiji, as portal16 produces it.
531    // Note the result still contains the multipolygon.
532    String wkt16 =
533        "POLYGON((-180.14832 -16.72643, -180.21423 -16.82899, -180.12085 -17.12058, -179.89838 -17.12845, -179.75006 -16.86054, -179.8764 -16.60277, -180.14832 -16.72643))";
534    query = visitor.buildQuery(new WithinPredicate(wkt16));

536        "(" + bbox + " AND contains('" + wktM + "', decimallatitude, decimallongitude) = TRUE)",

542        "POLYGON((179.85168 -16.72643, 179.78577 -16.82899, 179.87915 -17.12058, -179.89838 -17.12845, -179.75006 -16.86054, -179.8764 -16.60277, 179.85168 -16.72643))";

545        "(" + bbox + " AND contains('" + wktM + "', decimallatitude, decimallongitude) = TRUE)",
546        query);
547
548    // Tiny areas scattered around the world, all in a single multipolygon.
549    // Requires bounding boxes to avoid very slow Hive performance.
550    String wktMM =
551        "MULTIPOLYGON (((-109.42861 -27.13333, -109.42861 -27.13666, -109.43138 -27.13666, -109.43138 -27.13333, -109.42861 -27.13333)), "
552            + "((-109.42236 -27.10919, -109.42236 -27.11191, -109.42541 -27.11191, -109.42541 -27.10919, -109.42236 -27.10919)), "
553            + "((-174.35146 -19.80528, -174.35146 -19.81829, -174.36338 -19.81829, -174.36338 -19.80528, -174.35146 -19.80528)), "
554            + "((-173.94525 -18.71444, -173.96472 -18.71444, -173.96472 -18.68694, -173.94525 -18.68694, -173.94525 -18.71444)), "
555            + "((-173.91655 -18.66372, -173.94041 -18.66372, -173.94041 -18.63616, -173.91655 -18.63616, -173.91655 -18.66372)))";
556    String bboxMM =
557        "(decimallatitude >= -27.13666 AND decimallatitude <= -18.63616 AND (decimallongitude >= -174.36338 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42236)) AND "
558            + "(((decimallatitude >= -27.13666 AND decimallatitude <= -27.13333 AND (decimallongitude >= -109.43138 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42861)) OR "
559            + "(decimallatitude >= -27.11191 AND decimallatitude <= -27.10919 AND (decimallongitude >= -109.42541 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42236)) OR "
560            + "(decimallatitude >= -19.81829 AND decimallatitude <= -19.80528 AND (decimallongitude >= -174.36338 AND decimallongitude <= -174.35146)) OR "

725  @Test
726  public void testDateComparisons() throws QueryBuildingException {
727    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000", false);
728    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
729    assertEquals(
730        String.format(
731            "(lastinterpreted >= %s AND lastinterpreted < %s)",
732            Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli(),
733            Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
734        query);
735
736    // Include the range
737    p = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
738    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
739    assertEquals(
740        String.format("lastinterpreted < %s", Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
741        query);
742
743    p = new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
744    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
745    assertEquals(
746        String.format(
747            "lastinterpreted >= %s", Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
748        query);
749
750    // Exclude the range
751    p = new LessThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
752    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
753    assertEquals(
754        String.format("lastinterpreted < %s", Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
755        query);
756
757    p = new GreaterThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
758    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
759    assertEquals(
760        String.format(
761            "lastinterpreted >= %s", Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
762        query);
763  }

800    assertEquals(

802            "(eventdategte >= %s AND eventdatelte < %s)",

804            Instant.parse("2000-01-05T00:00:00Z").getEpochSecond()),

807    p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, "2000-01", false);
808    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
809    assertEquals(
810        String.format(
811            "(eventdategte >= %s AND eventdatelte < %s)",

816    p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, "2000-01,2000-03", false);
817    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
818    assertEquals(

825    p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, "2000", false);

827    assertEquals(

835    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);

870  /** Reusable method to test partial dates, i.e., dates with the format: yyyy, yyyy-MM. */
871  private void testPartialDate(String expectedFrom, String expectedTo, String value)
872      throws QueryBuildingException {
873    Range<Instant> range =
874        Range.closed(
875            expectedFrom == null ? null : Instant.parse(expectedFrom),
876            expectedTo == null ? null : Instant.parse(expectedTo));
877
878    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, value, false);
879    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
880
881    if (!range.hasUpperBound() && !range.hasLowerBound()) {
882      assertEquals("", query);
883    } else if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
884      assertEquals(
885          String.format("(lastinterpreted >= %s)", range.lowerEndpoint().toEpochMilli()), query);
886    } else if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
887      assertEquals(
888          String.format("(lastinterpreted < %s)", range.upperEndpoint().toEpochMilli()), query);
889    } else {
890      assertEquals(
891          String.format(
892              "(lastinterpreted >= %s AND lastinterpreted < %s)",
893              range.lowerEndpoint().toEpochMilli(), range.upperEndpoint().toEpochMilli()),
894          query);
895    }
896  }

1010  /** Reusable method to test number ranges. */
1011  private void testDoubleRange(String value) throws QueryBuildingException {
1012    Range<Double> range = SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(value);
1013
1014    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ELEVATION, value, false);
1015    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
1016
1017    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1018      assertEquals(String.format("elevation >= %s", range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue()), query);
1019    } else if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1020      assertEquals(String.format("elevation <= %s", range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()), query);
1021    } else {
1022      assertEquals(
1023          String.format(
1024              "((elevation >= %s) AND (elevation <= %s))",
1025              range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue(), range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()),
1026          query);
1027    }
1028  }

1057  @Test
1058  public void testIssues() throws QueryBuildingException {
1059    // EqualsPredicate
1060    String query =
1061        visitor.buildQuery(
1062            new EqualsPredicate<>(
1063                OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false));
1064    assertEquals("stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true)", query);
1065
1066    // InPredicate
1067    query =
1068        visitor.buildQuery(
1069            new InPredicate<>(
1070                OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE,
1071                List.of("TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", "TAXON_MATCH_NONE"),
1072                false));
1073    assertEquals(
1074        "(stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_NONE',true))",
1075        query);
1076
1077    // LikePredicate
1078    try {
1079      new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false);
1080      fail();
1081    } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
1082    }
1083
1084    // Not
1085    query =
1086        visitor.buildQuery(
1087            new NotPredicate(
1088                new EqualsPredicate<>(
1089                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false)));
1090    assertEquals("NOT stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true)", query);
1091
1092    // Not disjunction
1093    query =
1094        visitor.buildQuery(
1095            new NotPredicate(
1096                new DisjunctionPredicate(
1097                    List.of(
1098                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1099                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "COORDINATE_INVALID", false),
1100                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1101                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE", false),
1102                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1103                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "ZERO_COORDINATE", false),
1104                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1105                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "RECORDED_DATE_INVALID", false)))));
1106    assertEquals(
1107        "NOT (stringArrayContains(issue,'COORDINATE_INVALID',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'ZERO_COORDINATE',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'RECORDED_DATE_INVALID',true))",
1108        query);
1109
1110    // IsNotNull
1111    query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNotNullPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE));
1112    assertEquals("(issue IS NOT NULL AND size(issue) > 0)", query);
1113  }

1115  @Test
1116  public void testAllParamsExist() {
1117    List<Predicate> predicates = new ArrayList<>();
1118    for (OccurrenceSearchParameter param : OccurrenceSearchParameter.values()) {
1119      String value1 = "7";
1120      String value2 = "9";
1121      if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOMETRY == param) {
1122        predicates.add(new WithinPredicate("POLYGON ((30 10, 10 20, 20 40, 40 40, 30 10))"));
1123        continue;
1124      } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEO_DISTANCE == param) {
1125        predicates.add(new GeoDistancePredicate("10", "20", "10km"));
1126        continue;
1127      } else if (Optional.ofNullable(visitor.term(param))
1128          .map(SQLColumnsUtils::isVocabulary)
1129          .orElse(false)) {
1130        value1 = "valueA";
1131        value2 = "valueB";
1132      } else if (UUID.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1133        value1 = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
1134        value2 = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
1135      } else if (Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1136        value1 = "true";
1137        value2 = "false";
1138      } else if (Country.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1139        value1 = Country.GERMANY.getIso2LetterCode();
1140        value2 = Country.FRANCE.getIso3LetterCode();
1141      } else if (Language.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1142        value1 = Language.GERMAN.getIso2LetterCode();
1143        value2 = Language.FRENCH.getIso3LetterCode();
1144      } else if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1145        Enum<?>[] values = ((Class<Enum>) param.type()).getEnumConstants();
1146        value1 = values[0].name();
1147        value2 = values[1].name();
1148      } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1149        value1 = "2014-01-23";
1150        value2 = null;
1151      } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1152        value1 = "2014-01-23,2015-05";
1153        value2 = null;
1154      } else if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
1155          && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != param) {
1156        // some string parameters only accept letters; the geological time is numeric
1157        value1 = "A";
1158        value2 = "B";
1159      }
1160
1161      predicates.add(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, value1, false));
1162      if (value2 != null) {
1163        predicates.add(new InPredicate<>(param, List.of(value1, value2), false));
1164      }
1165    }
1166    ConjunctionPredicate and = new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1167    try {
1168      String allParams = visitor.buildQuery(and);
1169    } catch (QueryBuildingException e) {
1170      fail(e);
1171    }
1172  }

1174  @Test
1175  public void testVocabularies() {
1176    SQLColumnsUtils sqlColumnsUtils = new SQLColumnsUtils("occurrence");
1177
1178    Arrays.stream(OccurrenceSearchParameter.values())
1179        .filter(
1180            p ->
1181                Optional.ofNullable(visitor.term(p))
1182                    .map(SQLColumnsUtils::isVocabulary)
1183                    .orElse(false))
1184        .forEach(
1185            param -> {
1186              try {
1187                String hiveQueryField = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(visitor.term(param));
1188
1189                // EqualsPredicate
1190                String query = visitor.buildQuery(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, "valueOne", false));
1191                assertEquals("stringArrayContains(" + hiveQueryField + ",'valueOne',false)", query);
1192
1193                // InPredicate
1194                query =
1195                    visitor.buildQuery(
1196                        new InPredicate<>(param, List.of("valueOne", "valueTwo"), false));
1197                assertEquals(
1198                    "(stringArrayContains("
1199                        + hiveQueryField
1200                        + ",'valueOne',false) OR stringArrayContains("
1201                        + hiveQueryField
1202                        + ",'valueTwo',false))",
1203                    query);
1204
1205                // LikePredicate
1206                query = visitor.buildQuery(new LikePredicate<>(param, "value*", false));
1207                assertEquals("lower(" + hiveQueryField + ") LIKE lower('value%')", query);
1208
1209                // Not
1210                query =
1211                    visitor.buildQuery(
1212                        new NotPredicate(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, "valueOne", false)));
1213                assertEquals(
1214                    "NOT stringArrayContains(" + hiveQueryField + ",'valueOne',false)", query);
1215
1216                // IsNotNull
1217                query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNotNullPredicate<>(param));
1218                assertEquals(
1219                    "(" + hiveQueryField + " IS NOT NULL AND size(" + hiveQueryField + ") > 0)",
1220                    query);
1221
1222                // IsNull
1223                query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNullPredicate<>(param));
1224                if (visitor.isSQLArray(param)) {
1225                  assertEquals(
1226                      " (" + hiveQueryField + " IS NULL OR size(" + hiveQueryField + ") = 0) ",
1227                      query);
1228                } else {
1229                  assertEquals(hiveQueryField + " IS NULL", query);
1230                }
1231
1232              } catch (QueryBuildingException ex) {
1233                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
1234              }
1235            });
1236  }

1274  @Test
1275  public void testGeoTimePredicate() throws QueryBuildingException {
1276    Predicate predicate =
1277        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12", false);
1278    String query = visitor.buildQuery(predicate);
1279    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 12", query);
1280
1281    Predicate rangePredicate =
1282        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12,15", false);
1283    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1284    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12.0 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 15.0", query);
1285
1286    rangePredicate =
1287        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12,*", false);
1288    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1289    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12.0", query);
1290
1291    rangePredicate =
1292        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "*,15", false);
1293    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1294    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte <= 15.0", query);
1295
1296    Predicate greaterThanOrEqualsPredicate =
1297        new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12");
1298    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterThanOrEqualsPredicate);
1299    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12", query);
1300
1301    Predicate greaterThanPredicate =
1302        new GreaterThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12");
1303    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterThanPredicate);
1304    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte > 12", query);
1305
1306    Predicate lessThanOrEqualsPredicate =
1307        new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "15");
1308    query = visitor.buildQuery(lessThanOrEqualsPredicate);
1309    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte <= 15", query);
1310
1311    Predicate lessThanPredicate =
1312        new LessThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "15");
1313    query = visitor.buildQuery(lessThanPredicate);
1314    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt < 15", query);
1315
1316    ConjunctionPredicate greaterAndLessPredicate =
1317        new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(greaterThanPredicate, lessThanPredicate));
1318    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterAndLessPredicate);
1319    assertEquals("((geologicaltime.lte > 12) AND (geologicaltime.gt < 15))", query);
1320
1321    InPredicate inPredicate =
1322        new InPredicate(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, List.of("12", "15"), false);
1323    query = visitor.buildQuery(inPredicate);
1324    assertEquals(
1325        "((geologicaltime.gt >= 12 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 12) OR (geologicaltime.gt >= 15 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 15))",
1326        query);
1327
1328    IsNotNullPredicate notNullPredicate =
1329        new IsNotNullPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME);
1330    query = visitor.buildQuery(notNullPredicate);
1331    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt IS NOT NULL", query);
1332  }

1637  @Test
1638  public void testSequenceLengthComplexRange() throws QueryBuildingException {
1639    Predicate p =
1640        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1641            List.of(
1642                new InPredicate<>(
1643                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.OCCURRENCE_STATUS, List.of("PRESENT"), false),
1644                new DisjunctionPredicate(
1645                    List.of(
1646                        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1647                            List.of(
1648                                new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1649                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1650                                    "10"),
1651                                new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1652                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1653                                    "20"))),
1654                        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1655                            List.of(
1656                                new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1657                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1658                                    "20"),
1659                                new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1660                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1661                                    "30")))))));
1662    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
1663    assertEquals(
1664        "(((occurrencestatus IN('DETECTED'))) AND (((((dna.sequencelength >= 10) AND (dna.sequencelength <= 20))) OR (((dna.sequencelength >= 20) AND (dna.sequencelength <= 30))))))",
1665        query);
1666  }

1668  @Test
1669  public void conjunctionWithNotPredicateTest() throws QueryBuildingException {
1670    Predicate predicate =
1671        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1672            Arrays.asList(
1673                new InPredicate(
1674                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.DATASET_KEY,
1675                    Arrays.asList(
1676                        "b364710b-3f07-4876-a554-1943b702363f",
1677                        "6595e04b-13d2-4eac-933f-73786627b5a2"),
1678                    false // matchCase
1679                    ),
1680                new NotPredicate(
1681                    new ConjunctionPredicate(
1682                        Arrays.asList(
1683                            new InPredicate(
1684                                OccurrenceSearchParameter.INSTITUTION_KEY,
1685                                List.of("75f50140-830d-4630-a290-3d6e951a7c29"),
1686                                false),
1687                            new InPredicate(
1688                                OccurrenceSearchParameter.COLLECTION_KEY,
1689                                List.of("2294871f-f0f7-44b2-b707-e9511ff5a878"),
1690                                false))))));
1691    String query = visitor.buildQuery(predicate);
1692    String expectedQuery =
1693        "(((occurrence.datasetkey IN('b364710b-3f07-4876-a554-1943b702363f', '6595e04b-13d2-4eac-933f-73786627b5a2'))) AND (NOT (((institutionkey IN('75f50140-830d-4630-a290-3d6e951a7c29'))) AND ((collectionkey IN('2294871f-f0f7-44b2-b707-e9511ff5a878'))))))";
1694    assertEquals(expectedQuery, query);
1695  }

2472  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2473  // SQL injection tests
2474  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2475
2476  private static final String INJECTION_MARKER = "INJECTED";
2477
2478  /** Plain quote. */
2479  private static final String P_QUOTE = "x' OR INJECTED OR 'a'='a";
2480
2481  /** Backslash before the quote. */
2482  private static final String P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE = "x\\' OR INJECTED OR 'a'='a";
2483
2484  /** Two backslashes before the quote. */
2485  private static final String P_DOUBLE_BACKSLASH = "x\\\\' OR INJECTED --";
2486
2487  /** A trailing backslash escapes the closing quote, so the next value in a list breaks out. */
2488  private static final String P_TRAILING_BACKSLASH = "x\\";
2489
2490  private static final String P_FOLLOW_UP = ") OR INJECTED OR ('";
2491
2492  private static final List<String> INJECTION_PAYLOADS =
2493      List.of(P_QUOTE, P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE, P_DOUBLE_BACKSLASH, P_TRAILING_BACKSLASH, P_FOLLOW_UP);
2494
2495  /**
2496   * Removes Hive/Spark single-quoted string literals (backslash escapes) from the SQL, failing on
2497   * an unterminated literal, and checks the injection marker does not appear in what is left.
2498   */
2499  private static void assertNoInjection(String sql) {
2500    StringBuilder outside = new StringBuilder();
2501    boolean inLiteral = false;
2502    for (int i = 0; i < sql.length(); i++) {
2503      char c = sql.charAt(i);
2504      if (inLiteral) {
2505        if (c == '\\') {
2506          i++; // skip the escaped character
2507        } else if (c == '\'') {
2508          inLiteral = false;
2509        }
2510      } else if (c == '\'') {
2511        inLiteral = true;
2512      } else {
2513        outside.append(c);
2514      }
2515    }
2516    assertFalse(inLiteral, "Unterminated string literal in: " + sql);
2517    assertFalse(
2518        outside.toString().contains(INJECTION_MARKER), "Value escaped its string literal: " + sql);
2519  }
2520
2521  private void assertNoInjection(Predicate p) throws QueryBuildingException {
2522    assertNoInjection(visitor.buildQuery(p));
2523  }
2524
2525  @Test
2526  public void testAssertNoInjectionDetectsBreakout() {
2527    // Sanity check of the test helper itself, using the output the old escaping produced.
2528    assertThrows(
2529        AssertionError.class,
2530        () -> assertNoInjection("catalognumber = 'x\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a'"));
2531    assertThrows(AssertionError.class, () -> assertNoInjection("catalognumber = 'unterminated"));
2532    assertNoInjection("catalognumber = 'x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a'");
2533  }
2534
2535  @Test
2536  public void testQuoteEscapesBackslashesAndQuotes() {
2537    assertEquals("'abc'", SQLQueryVisitor.quote("abc"));
2538    assertEquals("'O\\'Shea'", SQLQueryVisitor.quote("O'Shea"));
2539    assertEquals("'x\\\\'", SQLQueryVisitor.quote("x\\"));
2540    assertEquals(
2541        "'x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a'", SQLQueryVisitor.quote(P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE));
2542    assertEquals("'x\\\\\\\\\\' OR INJECTED --'", SQLQueryVisitor.quote(P_DOUBLE_BACKSLASH));
2543    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.quote(null));
2544    for (String payload : INJECTION_PAYLOADS) {
2545      assertNoInjection("x = " + SQLQueryVisitor.quote(payload));
2546    }
2547  }
2548
2549  @Test
2550  public void testLikePatternBodyEscaping() {
2551    assertEquals("v_l%ue\\_\\%", SQLQueryVisitor.toSQLLikePatternBody("v?l*ue_%"));
2552    assertEquals("a\\\\\\\\b\\'c", SQLQueryVisitor.toSQLLikePatternBody("a\\b'c"));
2553    for (String payload : INJECTION_PAYLOADS) {
2554      assertNoInjection("x LIKE '" + SQLQueryVisitor.toSQLLikePatternBody(payload) + "'");
2555    }
2556  }
2557
2558  @Test
2559  public void testRequireNumericAndBoolean() {
2560    assertEquals("12", SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric("12"));
2561    assertEquals("-3.5", SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric(" -3.5 "));
2562    assertEquals("1.0E10", SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric("1.0E10"));
2563    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric("1 OR 1=1"));
2564    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric("NaN"));
2565    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.requireNumeric(null));
2566
2567    assertEquals("true", SQLQueryVisitor.requireBoolean("true"));
2568    assertEquals("FALSE", SQLQueryVisitor.requireBoolean("FALSE"));
2569    assertThrows(
2570        IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.requireBoolean("true OR 1=1"));
2571    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SQLQueryVisitor.requireBoolean(null));
2572  }
2573
2574  @Test
2575  public void testBackslashEscapingEquals() throws QueryBuildingException {
2576    assertEquals(
2577        "catalognumber = 'x\\\\'",
2578        visitor.buildQuery(new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, P_TRAILING_BACKSLASH, true)));
2579    assertEquals(
2580        "catalognumber = 'x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a'",
2581        visitor.buildQuery(new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE, true)));
2582    assertEquals(
2583        "lower(catalognumber) = lower('x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a')",
2584        visitor.buildQuery(new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE, false)));
2585    assertEquals(
2586        "stringArrayContains(recordedby,'x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a',false)",
2587        visitor.buildQuery(
2588            new EqualsPredicate<>(
2589                OccurrenceSearchParameter.RECORDED_BY, P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE, false)));

2601  @Test

2605        "catalognumber LIKE 'a\\\\\\\\b'",
2606        visitor.buildQuery(new LikePredicate<>(PARAM, "a\\b", true)));

2608        "catalognumber LIKE 'O\\'Sh%'",
2609        visitor.buildQuery(new LikePredicate<>(PARAM, "O'Sh*", true)));

2611        "stringArrayLike(recordedby,'x\\\\\\' OR INJECTED OR \\'a\\'=\\'a',false)",
2612        visitor.buildQuery(
2613            new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.RECORDED_BY, P_BACKSLASH_QUOTE, false)));

2626  @Test
2627  public void testInjectionPayloadsStayInsideLiterals() throws QueryBuildingException {
2628    UUID nub = Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY;
2629    List<String> largeList = new ArrayList<>(INJECTION_PAYLOADS);
2630    IntStream.range(0, 60).forEach(i -> largeList.add(String.valueOf(i)));
2631
2632    for (String payload : INJECTION_PAYLOADS) {
2633      List<String> values = List.of(payload, P_FOLLOW_UP);
2634      for (boolean matchCase : new boolean[] {true, false}) {
2635        // Plain string column
2636        assertNoInjection(new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, payload, matchCase));
2637        assertNoInjection(new InPredicate<>(PARAM, values, matchCase));
2638        assertNoInjection(new LikePredicate<>(PARAM, payload, matchCase));
2639        assertNoInjection(new NotPredicate(new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, payload, matchCase)));
2640        assertNoInjection(
2641            new DisjunctionPredicate(
2642                List.of(
2643                    new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, payload, matchCase),
2644                    new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, P_FOLLOW_UP, matchCase))));
2645
2646        // Array column
2647        assertNoInjection(
2648            new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.RECORDED_BY, payload, matchCase));
2649        assertNoInjection(
2650            new InPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.RECORDED_BY, values, matchCase));
2651        assertNoInjection(
2652            new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.RECORDED_BY, payload, matchCase));
2653
2654        // Taxonomic columns
2655        assertNoInjection(
2656            new EqualsPredicate<>(
2657                OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, payload, matchCase, nub));
2658        assertNoInjection(
2659            new LikePredicate<>(
2660                OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, payload, nub, matchCase));
2661        assertNoInjection(
2662            new InPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, values, matchCase, nub));
2663      }
2664    }
2665  }

2667  @Test
2668  public void testVocabularyInjection() {
2669    Arrays.stream(OccurrenceSearchParameter.values())
2670        .filter(
2671            p ->
2672                Optional.ofNullable(visitor.term(p))
2673                    .map(SQLColumnsUtils::isVocabulary)
2674                    .orElse(false))
2675        .forEach(
2676            param -> {
2677              for (String payload : INJECTION_PAYLOADS) {
2678                try {
2679                  try {
2680                    assertNoInjection(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, payload, false));
2681                    assertNoInjection(
2682                        new InPredicate<>(param, List.of(payload, P_FOLLOW_UP), false));
2683                    assertNoInjection(new LikePredicate<>(param, payload, false));
2684                  } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
2685                  }
2686                } catch (QueryBuildingException e) {
2687                  fail(e);
2688                }
2689              }
2690            });
2691  }

2693  @Test
2694  public void testGeologicalTimeMustBeNumeric() {
2695    // GEOLOGICAL_TIME is a String parameter, so the API doesn't validate it, and it is written to
2696    // the SQL unquoted.
2697    String payload = "12 OR INJECTED";
2698    OccurrenceSearchParameter gt = OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME;
2699    for (Predicate p :
2700        List.<Predicate>of(
2701            new EqualsPredicate<>(gt, payload, false),
2702            new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(gt, payload),
2703            new GreaterThanPredicate<>(gt, payload),
2704            new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(gt, payload),
2705            new LessThanPredicate<>(gt, payload),
2706            new InPredicate<>(gt, List.of("12", payload), false))) {
2707      assertThrows(QueryBuildingException.class, () -> visitor.buildQuery(p), p.toString());
2708    }
2709  }
